title: The Agent Operating System (AOS): A Reference Operating Architecture for Distributed Agentic Systems
title_zh: Agent Operating System（AOS）：面向分布式智能体系统的参考操作架构
abstract_en: Large language models have transformed artificial intelligence from isolated prediction services into components of long-running, distributed systems that reason, invoke tools, retrieve external state, delegate tasks, and act on behalf of users and organizations. The surrounding ecosystem has responded with agent frameworks, workflow engines, model-serving platforms, memory systems, communication protocols, and observability tools. These technologies improve execution, but they do not provide a stable, implementation-independent operating architecture for governing intent, selecting capabilities, preserving authority across delegation, controlling uncertainty, coordinating runtime behavior, and reconstructing why consequential actions occurred. This paper proposes the Agent Operating System (AOS), a vendor-neutral reference operating architecture for distributed agentic systems. AOS contains two internal planes: a Control & Governance Plane responsible for intent, policy, trust, authority, confidence, auditability, observability, and human oversight; and a Runtime & Coordination Plane responsible for agent lifecycle, workflow coordination, model and tool routing, context and memory coordination, scheduling, traffic management, and runtime assurance. Platform services, Linux or Windows, container runtimes, and physical infrastructure remain outside the AOS boundary and are integrated through explicit interfaces. The paper specifies AOS concepts, invariants, interface objects, optimization objectives, deployment profiles, and reliability responsibilities. It also identifies tradeoffs and unresolved research questions. AOS is not presented as a replacement for existing frameworks or infrastructure; it is proposed as the operating architecture through which heterogeneous components can be composed into governable, reliable, observable, and interoperable agentic systems.
abstract_zh: 本文提出 Agent Operating System（AOS），一个厂商中立的分布式智能体系统参考操作架构。随着 LLM 从独立预测服务演变为可长期运行、调用工具、检索外部状态、委派任务并代表用户行动的系统组件，现有 agent frameworks、workflow engines、model-serving platforms、memory systems、communication protocols 与 observability tools 虽提升了执行能力，却缺乏稳定、实现无关的架构来治理意图、选择能力、保持委派中的权限、控制不确定性、协调运行时行为，并追溯关键行动原因。AOS 将内部划分为 Control & Governance Plane 与 Runtime & Coordination Plane：前者负责 intent、policy、trust、authority、confidence、auditability、observability 与 human oversight；后者负责 agent lifecycle、workflow coordination、model/tool routing、context and memory coordination、scheduling、traffic management 与 runtime assurance。AOS 明确将 Linux/Windows、容器运行时、平台服务和物理基础设施置于边界之外，通过显式接口集成。论文定义了 AOS 的核心概念、不变量、接口对象、优化目标、部署形态和可靠性职责，并讨论权衡与开放研究问题。AOS 并非替代现有框架或基础设施，而是提供一种可组合异构组件的操作架构，使智能体系统更可治理、可靠、可观测并具互操作性。
key_points_zh: 论文将 AOS 定位为 vendor-neutral 的参考操作架构，而非新框架或基础设施替代品，用于统一组织异构 agentic system 组件。
AOS 的 Control & Governance Plane 负责意图、策略、信任、权限、置信度、审计、可观测性和人工监督，强调可治理与可追责。
Runtime & Coordination Plane 负责智能体生命周期、工作流协调、模型与工具路由、上下文/记忆协调、调度、流量管理和运行时保障。
AOS 明确区分自身边界与底层平台：Linux、Windows、容器运行时、平台服务和物理基础设施均通过显式接口接入。
论文系统化给出概念、不变量、接口对象、优化目标、部署配置和可靠性职责，并指出分布式智能体系统在权限传递、不确定性控制和事后追溯上的研究挑战。

llm_assessment.comment: Very strong domain fit as a reference architecture for governable, observable, interoperable distributed agent systems, though mostly conceptual.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 作为可治理、可观测、可互操作分布式智能体系统的参考架构，它非常契合该领域，但主要偏概念性。
